nodes.description: Private mapping tracking token balances of each address in ANT.
Private nested mapping of owner=>spender=>allowance used by transferFrom/approve.
Public address used as the blacklist bot recipient checked in _transfer.
Public address exempted from the blacklist transfer cap in _transfer.
Total token supply, mutable via setFeeTotal which mints new tokens.
Maximum transfer amount enforced when sending to the bot address.
Private owner address set in the Ownable constructor and gate for onlyOwner.
onlyOwner setter that writes _tBotAddress.
onlyOwner setter that writes _tBlackAddress.
onlyOwner privileged function that increases _tTotal and mints balance to the caller.
onlyOwner setter that recomputes _maxBlack with an unchecked multiplication.
External ERC20 transfer forwarding msg.sender, recipient and amount to _transfer.
External ERC20 transferFrom that moves tokens and decreases allowance.
Core internal transfer applying blacklist cap and SafeMath balance updates.
External approve forwarding msg.sender and spender to _approve.
Private allowance writer validating owner and spender are non-zero.
onlyOwner function that reassigns _owner to a new account.
Caller-controlled address used as sender, owner and privileged caller throughout ANT.
Unchecked multiplication maxTxBlackPercent * 10**18 that can overflow silently.
Low-level recipient.call{value:amount} in Address library that forwards all gas.
Address parameter of setBlackListBot stored into _tBotAddress.
Address parameter of setBlackAddress stored into _tBlackAddress.
Amount parameter of setFeeTotal used to mint supply and balance.
Percent parameter of setMaxTxBlack multiplied by 10**18.
Sender address parameter of _transfer used for balance debit.
Recipient address parameter of _transfer checked against _tBotAddress.
Amount parameter of _transfer used for balances and blacklist cap comparison.

edges.reason: msg.sender is used as the sender argument when transfer calls _transfer.
transfer delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
transferFrom delegates execution to the internal _transfer routine.
approve delegates execution to the private _approve routine.
transferFrom calls _approve to decrease the spender allowance.
setBlackListBot writes the privileged _tBotAddress state variable.
setBlackAddress writes the privileged _tBlackAddress state variable.
setFeeTotal inflates the total supply through _tTotal.
setFeeTotal mints new tokens directly into the caller balance in _balances.
msg.sender determines the mint beneficiary inside setFeeTotal.
setMaxTxBlack performs the unchecked multiplication operation.
Result of the unchecked multiplication is written into _maxBlack.
setMaxTxBlack assigns the derived value to the _maxBlack limit.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner modifier to call setBlackListBot.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner modifier to call setBlackAddress.
msg.sender must satisfy the onlyOwner modifier to call setMaxTxBlack.
msg.sender must be the owner to call transferOwnership.
transferOwnership reassigns the privileged _owner state variable.
blackListAddress parameter flows into the _tBotAddress write of setBlackListBot.
blackAddress parameter flows into the _tBlackAddress write of setBlackAddress.
amount parameter flows into the _tTotal and _balances updates of setFeeTotal.
maxTxBlackPercent parameter feeds the unchecked multiplication in setMaxTxBlack.
sender parameter is debited from _balances inside _transfer.
recipient parameter is compared to _tBotAddress and credited inside _transfer.
amount parameter drives balance arithmetic and blacklist cap check in _transfer.
msg.sender is used as spender when transferFrom reduces the allowance.
msg.sender is used as the owner argument in approve/_approve.
_approve writes the allowance entry into _allowances.
_transfer updates sender and recipient entries of _balances.
_transfer reads _maxBlack for the blacklist transfer cap check.
_transfer reads _tBotAddress to detect transfers to the bot address.
_transfer reads _tBlackAddress to exempt the blacklist address from the cap.
Low-level call forwards control to a recipient contract which can reenter token transfer logic before state finalization.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter exists only to feed the _tBotAddress write inside setBlackListBot.
Parameter exists only to feed the _tBlackAddress write inside setBlackAddress.
Parameter is consumed entirely by the minting arithmetic of setFeeTotal.
Parameter is consumed by the unchecked multiplication leading to the _maxBlack write.
Sender parameter is only used within the debit logic of _transfer.
Recipient parameter is only used within the credit and blacklist logic of _transfer.
Amount parameter is only used within the balance arithmetic of _transfer.
